import json, struct, subprocess, sys, zlib

def rec(payload, seq, kind, txid, crc_delta=0, decl_len=None, seq_override=None):
    n = len(payload) if decl_len is None else decl_len
    s = seq if seq_override is None else seq_override
    header = struct.pack("<IIBI", n, s, kind, txid)
    crc = (zlib.crc32(header + payload) & 0xffffffff) ^ crc_delta
    return header + payload + struct.pack("<I", crc)

def patch(page, off, data, count_override=None):
    c = len(data) if count_override is None else count_override
    return struct.pack("<HHH", page, off, c) + data

def seal(payloads, count=None, digest=None):
    c = len(payloads) if count is None else count
    d = (zlib.crc32(b"".join(payloads)) & 0xffffffff) if digest is None else digest
    return struct.pack("<II", c, d)

def run(cases):
    inp = "".join(json.dumps(c) + "\n" for c in cases)
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/app/main.py"], input=inp, text=True,
                       capture_output=True, cwd="/app")
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr
    return [json.loads(x) for x in p.stdout.splitlines()]
EOF
